title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists - Solution
approach: Dual pointer traversal with head swap on completion.
intuition: Given the heads of two singly linked-lists headA and headB, return the node at which the two lists intersect. If they do not intersect, return null.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Dual pointer traversal with head swap on completion.
common_mistakes: If you traverse list A and then switch to list B's head, and vice-versa, the path lengths will equalize.
